title: 美国7月CPI同比升3.4%，环比升0.1%，通胀继续降温
summary: 美国劳工统计局8月12日发布数据显示，7月CPI同比升3.4%（核心CPI同比升2.5%），均符合或低于预期，通胀降温势头延续。市场据此大幅降低美联储加息预期，利率期货显示9月维持现有利率区间（3.50-3.75%）的概率升至约60%。
why: 通胀数据降温是本周美股创新高的核心驱动力；联储政策预期转向偏鸽有利于成长股估值，对卖出期权策略隐含波动率也会带来影响。

title: S&P 500 Hits All-Time Intraday High of 7,814.88 as Inflation Cools; Nasdaq Tops 26,800
summary: The S&P 500 notched a fresh all-time intraday high of 7,814.88 and closed above 7,800 for the first time ever on August 13, driven by cooler July CPI data and strong AI-related earnings. The Nasdaq Composite gained 0.81% to close at 26,803, boosted by tech and AI names.
why: 美股创历史新高，技术面突破标志性整数关口，短期情绪偏多；通胀降温利好成长股估值，持仓科技消费标的及sell put策略受益。

title: US Retail Sales Fall 0.6% in July, Most in 14 Months, as Tax Refund Boost Fades
summary: US retail sales dropped 0.6% in July—the first monthly decline in nine months and the largest drop in 14 months—well below the consensus forecast for a 0.1% gain. Non-store retailers fell 2.2%, motor vehicle sales slid 1.8%. The pullback follows the fading of Amazon Prime Day tax-refund spending and falling gas prices.
why: 消费走弱可能加剧经济放缓担忧，利空周期性消费板块；若触发衰退担忧则可能推动联储更早降息，整体对持有高质量成长股影响偏中性，sell put需留意波动率可能上升。

title: 中国央行8月14日开展1万亿元6个月期买断式逆回购，同步开展隔夜逆回购操作
summary: 中国人民银行8月13日宣布，将于8月14日以买断式逆回购方式投放1万亿元6个月期资金（期限185天），实现对同期到期量的等量对冲；同时披露8月14日及17-19日每日开展不超过6000亿元隔夜逆回购。央行《2026年第二季度货币政策执行报告》同期发布，表态继续实施适度宽松货币政策。
why: 央行维护流动性充裕信号明确，短期利好A股和港股情绪；宽松货币立场配合适度宽松指引，对消费科技持仓形成正面背景。

title: Oil Holds Drop Near $87/Barrel as Hormuz Deal Remains Elusive, Tanker Attacks Continue
summary: Brent crude fell more than 2% on August 13 to close near $87.07/barrel, with WTI also sliding over 2% to settle near $81.25/barrel. Oil held those losses on August 14 as negotiations toward a Strait of Hormuz reopening deal remained stalled while fresh attacks on tankers and energy infrastructure kept supply disruption risk elevated.
why: 油价下跌一定程度缓解通胀压力，但霍尔木兹海峡持续紧张是尾部风险；对持仓的直接影响有限，需留意能源成本对消费类企业利润率的影响。

title: 腾讯Q2 2026营收2048亿元(+11%)，AI资本支出暴增176%至528亿元推自由现金流2005年来首次转负
summary: 腾讯8月12日发布Q2 2026业绩：总营收2048亿元，同比+11%；非IFRS归母净利润684亿元，同比+9%，低于市场预期；单季资本支出528亿元，同比暴增176%，自由现金流转为-138亿元，为2005年以来首次为负。国内游戏营收473亿元(+17%)，营销服务收入436亿元(+22%)。8月13日港股跌4.46%，ADR跌5.44%。四家大行维持买入/增持评级，目标价HK$650-758。
why: AI资本支出大幅超预期引发短期盈利担忧，股价大跌后估值是否具吸引力成关键；若持有腾讯，短期波动率上升可考虑covered call机会；中长期关注AI投入能否转化为营收增量。

title: Intel Prices Upsized $20 Billion Stock Offering at $95/Share to Fund AI Foundry Expansion
summary: Intel priced an upsized registered public offering of 210.5 million shares at $95/share, raising approximately $19.7 billion net, increased from the initial $15 billion target. The offering is expected to close August 12. Proceeds will fund capital expenditures and working capital as Intel accelerates its foundry expansion to serve AI chip manufacturing demand. Intel's Q2 2026 revenue was $16.1B (+25% YoY), its fastest growth since 2011.
why: 巨额增发稀释约4%股本，短期压制股价；但资本充裕为代工扩张提供支撑，是英特尔AI战略关键一步；dilution风险影响INTC期权定价，需调整行权价预期。增发8月12日交割后股本变化正在纳入分析师模型，事件影响仍在市场消化中。

title: Micron Ventures Launches $250 Million Paradigm Fund to Invest Across Full AI Technology Stack
summary: Micron Technology launched the Micron Ventures Paradigm Fund—its third and largest venture fund at $250 million—on August 13, bringing total Micron Ventures capital commitment to $550 million. The fund will invest from AI model architectures and compute infrastructure to enterprise applications and physical AI/robotics. MU shares jumped 4.23% on the news. MU has guided for very tight memory supply through 2027+.
why: Micron通过VC布局表明管理层对AI存储长期需求的强烈信心；结合NAND/DRAM供给偏紧至2027年的展望，MU中长期逻辑进一步强化；sell put可考虑MU下行保护。

title: Nvidia Signs $500B AI Compute Infrastructure Financing MOUs with Apollo, BlackRock, Blackstone, Brookfield, Goldman Sachs and KKR
summary: Nvidia announced MOUs with six major Wall Street institutions to establish independent AI compute financing platforms mobilizing over $500 billion in third-party capital for AI infrastructure buildout based on Nvidia hardware. GPU compute power is treated as collateral similar to infrastructure assets. Q2 FY2027 earnings on August 26 are expected to show ~$94-95B revenue (vs. guidance of $91B). BofA expects guidance raise to $107-108B for next quarter.
why: 延续报道：$500B AI基础设施融资协议（8月10日）仍在市场广泛讨论，叠加8月26日财报前瞻（分析师预期+95% YoY营收），英伟达AI生态持续扩展；对持仓科技股形成利好，Nvidia earnings day波动率高，sell put需谨慎管理风险。

title: Walmart to Report Q2 FY2027 Earnings August 20, 2026; Consensus EPS $0.74, Revenue $186.9B
summary: Walmart will release Q2 FY2027 results before the US market opens on August 20, 2026, followed by a 7 a.m. CDT conference call hosted by CEO John Furner and CFO John David Rainey. Analyst consensus expects EPS of $0.74 and revenue of $186.9B. Walmart, including Sam's Club, has been a beneficiary of value-seeking consumers amid elevated inflation.
why: 沃尔玛财报即将发布，山姆会员店表现尤为受关注；零售消费数据将为宏观消费趋势提供额外信号；若沃尔玛业绩超预期，可参考其对消费者行为的指引作为零售板块风向标。
